lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: The reviewer's CRITICAL finding (STORIES_COMPACT_THRESHOLD off-by-one at budget==4) is fixed: threshold raised from SECTION_CHROME_HEIGHT+1 to SECTION_CHROME_HEIGHT+2 so computeStoriesLayout's chrome branch is only entered once its windowSize floor (Math.max(1, budget - SECTION_CHROME_HEIGHT - 1)) is already >= 1 on its own, i.e. the floor can never silently re-donate the line reserved for the '...N more' overflow hint. Added a regression test at the exact rows=26/budget==4 boundary in test/dashboard.test.ts (new describe-block test, alongside the existing rows=29/60/24 cases, all still green). Raised both src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (826->837) and test/dashboard.test.ts (2075->2098) file-size ceilings with a dated _ref note. bun run check:all is fully green (typecheck, tests, lint, file-size, debt-markers, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps).
